parameters.content:
KELPIE TEMPLATE. Before import, replace:
__CLIENT_NAME__ (e.g. LumberJord)
__CLIENT_SLUG__ (e.g. lumberjord)
__CLIENT_EMAIL__ (owner notify inbox)
__CLIENT_DOMAIN__ (e.g. lumberjord.com.au)

After import: run the Setup branch once in the UI, paste the new spreadsheetId into Append Ledger Row (replacing PASTE_SHEET_ID_AFTER_SETUP), then activate.

API create/update accepts ONLY name, nodes, connections, settings.
